basis: Brazil: girls' and boys' top-10 lists for 2024 and 2025 from civil-registry data published by Arpen-Brasil (Portal da Transparência do Registro Civil; 2025 leaders Helena 28,271 and Ravi 21,982 registrations, released December 2025), extended to about 20 per gender with the next-ranked names in BabyCenter Brasil's 2025 ranking (girls: Sophia, Isabela, Olívia, Luísa, Liz, Manuela, Ayla, Esther, Lívia, Eloá; boys: Benício, Isaac, Pedro, Gabriel, Matheus, Anthony, Levi, Joaquim, Benjamin, Lucas). Names already in the library (matched ignoring accents) are listed in alsoPopular.

meaning.en: Torch; shining light
meaning.es: Antorcha; luz brillante
meaning.de: Fackel; leuchtendes Licht
meaning.fr: Torche ; lumière brillante
meaning.pt: Tocha; luz brilhante

meaning.en: Beloved (from the Basque maite)
meaning.es: Amada (del vasco maite)

meaning.en: From the Roman family name Caecilius; linked to Latin caecus, 'blind'
meaning.tr: Roma'daki Caecilius aile adından; Latince caecus ('kör') sözcüğüyle ilişkilendirilir
meaning.es: Del nombre de familia romano Caecilius; relacionado con el latín caecus, «ciego»
meaning.de: Vom römischen Familiennamen Caecilius; verwandt mit lateinisch caecus, „blind“
meaning.fr: Du nom de famille romain Caecilius ; lié au latin caecus, « aveugle »
meaning.pt: Do nome de família romano Caecilius; ligado ao latim caecus, 'cego'

meaning.en: Maria ('beloved'; the Virgin Mary) + Cecília (from the Roman name Caecilius)
meaning.tr: Maria ('sevilen'; Meryem Ana) + Cecília (Roma'daki Caecilius adından)
meaning.es: Maria («amada»; la Virgen María) + Cecília (del nombre romano Caecilius)
meaning.de: Maria („geliebt“; die Jungfrau Maria) + Cecília (vom römischen Namen Caecilius)
meaning.fr: Maria (« aimée » ; la Vierge Marie) + Cecília (du nom romain Caecilius)
meaning.pt: Maria ('amada'; a Virgem Maria) + Cecília (do nome romano Caecilius)

meaning.es: Laurel; coronada de laureles

meaning.en: Italian form of Antonia, from the Roman family name Antonius; often glossed as 'priceless'
meaning.tr: Antonia'nın İtalyanca biçimi, Roma'daki Antonius aile adından; çoğu zaman 'paha biçilmez' diye yorumlanır
meaning.es: Forma italiana de Antonia, del nombre de familia romano Antonius; a menudo interpretado como «inestimable»
meaning.de: Italienische Form von Antonia, vom römischen Familiennamen Antonius; oft als „unschätzbar“ gedeutet
meaning.fr: Forme italienne d'Antonia, du nom de famille romain Antonius ; souvent interprété comme « inestimable »
meaning.pt: Forma italiana de Antônia, do nome de família romano Antonius; muitas vezes interpretado como 'inestimável'

meaning.en: Egyptian goddess of motherhood and magic (Greek form of Aset)
meaning.tr: Mısır'ın annelik ve büyü tanrıçası (Aset adının Yunanca biçimi)
meaning.es: Diosa egipcia de la maternidad y la magia (forma griega de Aset)

meaning.en: From the French Héloïse; linked to Germanic words for 'healthy, whole' and 'wide'
meaning.tr: Fransızca Héloïse'dan; Cermen dillerinde 'sağlıklı, bütün' ve 'geniş' anlamına gelen sözcüklerle ilişkilendirilir
meaning.es: Del francés Héloïse; relacionado con palabras germánicas que significan «sano, entero» y «amplio»
meaning.de: Vom französischen Héloïse; verwandt mit germanischen Wörtern für „gesund, heil“ und „weit“
meaning.fr: Du français Héloïse ; lié à des mots germaniques signifiant « sain, entier » et « large »
meaning.pt: Do francês Héloïse; ligado a palavras germânicas para 'saudável, inteira' e 'ampla'
